title: Bio-Blurring Talc-Free Loose Setting Powder
descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Vegan✓ Loose Powder Formula✓ Cruelty-Free✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Light Coverage

What it is: A clean, skincare-infused loose powder that blurs imperfections, smooths skin, and optimizes makeup performance.


Coverage: Light


Finish: Natural


Formulation: Loose Powder


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Fermented Arnica: Visibly reduces redness and irritation.

- Plant Squalane: Protects and boosts hydration.

- Tourmaline: Supports cellular energy.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.


What Else You Need to Know: This multitasking magician combines talc-free, gel-powder technology and finely milled pigme

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Using a fluffy powder brush or sponge, press into mesh screen to release loose powder. Tap off excess.
-Can be used alone on clean skin to blur, to set makeup, or to visibly brighten targeted areas of the face.
Ingredients+
-Fermented Arnica: Visibly reduces redness and irritation.
-Plant Squalane: Protects and boosts hydration.
-Tourmaline: Supports cellular energy.

Mica, Squalane, Diphenyl Dimethicone/Vinyl Diphenyl Dimethicone/Silsesquioxane Crosspolymer, Methyl Methacrylate Crosspolymer, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Arnica Montana Flower Extract**, Pseudozyma Epicola/Sunflower Seed Oil Ferment Extract Filtrate, Tourmaline, Tocopherol, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Caprylyl Glycol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Tocopheryl Acetate, Glycerin, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, C20-24 Olefin, Alumina. May Contain/Peut Contenir: (+/-) CI 77491/77492/77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide), CI 19140 (Yellow 5 Lake).
**Fermented.

The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
